meaning: An explicit project output layout projects one checked reconciled project into one coherent native source root without changing authored domain meaning, selected native profiles, qualified identities, or the compiler-native plan.
selection: The domainspec.project-layout/v1 output-layout option is available only for whole-project reconciled TypeScript, Python, and Rust builds and currentness verification. Omission preserves compiler-native output exactly. The existing domainspec.application-layout/v1 remains unchanged. Unknown layouts and node-scoped project layouts reject without fallback.
common_structure: Every language has one native source root. Feature-owned artifacts are grouped by feature and then by domain or application role. Shared generated domain support is outside every feature. Language-native manifests, package namespaces, module initializers, and module wiring remain explicit artifacts rather than inferred filesystem behavior.
typescript: Emit feature modules under src/features/<feature>/<domain-or-application>/<role>/ and shared Enum support under src/shared/domain/. Rewrite only static generated import and re-export specifiers required by relocation. Keep embedded source and descriptor paths as canonical compiler-native identities.
python: Emit one source root at src/ while retaining the selected portable package namespace beneath it. Place feature modules under <package>/features/<feature>/<domain-or-application>/<role>/ and shared runtime support under <package>/shared/domain/. Rewrite static relative imports and preserve required package initializers.
rust: Emit Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock at the project root. Emit node modules under src/features/<feature>/<domain-or-application>/<role>/ using portable native identifiers, rewrite crate module paths, and deterministically regenerate the complete mod.rs hierarchy and src/lib.rs. Shared support, when present, belongs under src/shared/domain/.
identity: The projected view and receipt bind this definition digest, the original checked view digest, selected output-layout identifier, complete projected artifacts, rewritten native imports, and the unchanged registered project-plan identity.
verification: Source and snapshot planning must agree. Exact local publication must reject existing targets and verification must detect missing, changed, surplus, aliased, or stale receipt paths. Focused native TypeScript, Python, and Rust checks must consume the projected files rather than the compiler-native private workspace.
compatibility: This is an additive output view. It does not change compiler-native artifact paths, existing application-layout paths, selected generation profiles, source schemas, semantic verification, or default CLI behavior.
non_effects: No second source parser or domain model
No generated provider execution during planning or publication
No profile admission or default layout cutover
No publication, release, deployment, or external effect
